context: A rural local hosts a uni reporter discussing tourism flows
purpose: Teach: 県民/中年/日本国/同志/アラブ/モンゴル/高価/形状

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日は取材を受けてくださってありがとうございます。県民の皆さんの観光に対する本音を伺いたいんです。
lines.en: Thank you for accepting the interview today. I'd like to hear the locals' honest views on tourism.
lines.style: Polite university reporter opening with formal gratitude and clear purpose.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ええよ、ええよ。最近はアラブの方やらモンゴルからのお客さんまで来てびっくりしとるわ。
lines.en: Sure, sure. Lately we've even had visitors from the Arab world and Mongolia—it's quite a surprise.
lines.style: Warm rural older man, relaxed regional speech, casual welcoming tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そんなに国際的なんですね。日本国民全体で見ても、地方への観光客は増えているそうです。
lines.en: That's surprisingly international. Even looking at all Japanese citizens, rural tourism is reportedly growing.
lines.style: Curious reporter framing the local situation within national-level trends.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: せやけど、土産物の値段が急に高価になってもうて、中年のうちの息子らも正直ついていけんわ。
lines.en: But souvenir prices suddenly became so expensive—even my middle-aged sons honestly can't keep up.
lines.style: Candid grumble from older local, mixing humor with mild complaint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。観光客が好む商品の形状やデザインも、昔とはずいぶん変わったんでしょうか。
lines.en: I see. Have the shapes and designs of products tourists prefer changed a lot from before?
lines.style: Probing follow-up question seeking concrete cultural observations from interviewee.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 変わった変わった。昔は素朴な木彫りやったのに、今は変なキャラクターグッズばっかりや。
lines.en: Oh, hugely. It used to be simple wood carvings, but now it's all weird character goods.
lines.style: Animated local lamenting commercialization with vivid concrete examples.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 町おこしの同志として伺いますが、地元の方々が一番大切にしたいものは何ですか。
lines.en: Asking as a comrade in town revitalization, what do locals most want to protect?
lines.style: Earnest closing question framing villagers as partners in a shared cause.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: そりゃ人と人のつながりよ。観光は嬉しいけど、静かな暮らしも守りたいんや。
lines.en: It's the bonds between people. We welcome tourism, but we also want to protect our quiet life.
lines.style: Heartfelt sincere conclusion balancing openness with rooted local values.
